style: Built-in image generation. Wide 3:2, no lettering, logos, screenshots or real client artwork. Style reference: UTMB diorama.

assets.title: Meet you in the Highlands.
assets.scene: The designer creates an orange finisher medal beside a saola in the Da Lat highlands.

assets.title: Brand consultant & brand design
assets.scene: The designer connects glowing turquoise energy cubes, a giant teal battery, solar panels and a miniature wind turbine into one coherent brand system on a neat technical workbench. Teal, navy and lime accents.

assets.title: The beginning of a design journey
assets.scene: The designer celebrates his first design graduation project: sketchbook, geometric colour swatches, drawing pen and a golden first-prize trophy on an art-school desk. Warm yellow, cobalt and lime accents.

assets.title: A nation behind its team
assets.scene: The designer creates a campaign beside a miniature football pitch with a red-shirted footballer, a football, red pennant flags and cheering block spectators. Vietnamese football energy, red and gold accents.

assets.title: Everyday products, clear stories
assets.scene: The designer arranges a campaign set of a miniature refrigerator, washing machine and electric fan, with three floating blank social-post tiles and a blue camera. Blue, white and cyan accents.

assets.title: A playful side of Gery
assets.scene: The designer builds a playful snack world with chocolate wafer sticks, cream sandwich biscuits, a tiny smiling biscuit companion and orange-yellow blank packaging cubes. Orange, cream and chocolate accents.

assets.title: A fresh perspective on laundry
assets.scene: The designer stands beside a washing machine, fresh folded towels, floating sparkling soap bubbles and two blank detergent bottles in a laundry campaign studio. Bright green, white and aqua accents.

assets.title: The character of coffee
assets.scene: The designer draws a large steaming ceramic coffee cup surrounded by coffee beans, a little coffee plant, material swatches and a small artisanal cafe counter. Terracotta, espresso and cream accents.

assets.title: A considered coffee experience
assets.scene: The designer rearranges a miniature elegant cafe interior with a curved service counter, timber seating, pendant lamps, a potted tree and an oversized coffee cup. Warm wood, cream and muted olive accents.

assets.title: Coffee, connected
assets.scene: The designer sits on the corner of a giant desktop monitor showing only abstract blank rectangular website blocks, joined by blocky cables to a takeaway coffee cup and miniature cafe. Warm orange, cream and charcoal accents.

assets.title: Small details, one visual system
assets.scene: The designer stands on a giant tilted smartphone assembling chunky blank app tiles, tiny coffee cup icons and simple geometric interface components into a tidy grid. Cream, coral and warm coffee accents.

assets.title: Built for the seller community
assets.scene: The designer helps two tiny friendly shopkeepers assemble a bustling orange miniature marketplace, with unlettered shopping bags, parcels, shop awnings and a megaphone. Orange, peach and cream accents.

assets.title: Campaigns that invite action
assets.scene: The designer climbs a small staircase into a giant upright blank landing-page portal, surrounded by orange parcels, a mouse cursor arrow made from cubes and blank call-to-action blocks. Orange, white and charcoal accents.

assets.title: One campaign, many touchpoints
assets.scene: The designer coordinates an orange central campaign hub connected to a tiny billboard, mobile screen, delivery parcel and a blank retail poster. The hub has branching cube paths. Orange, warm cream and cyan accents.

assets.title: A familiar brand, refreshed online
assets.scene: The designer paints a red coffee-themed desktop website on a large monitor with abstract blank panels, a little red cafe facade and a steaming iced coffee beside it. Red, white, coffee brown and leaf green accents.

assets.title: Refreshing the daily coffee ritual
assets.scene: The designer rides a miniature red takeaway coffee cup beside a giant smartphone with blank menu tiles and an iced coffee order. A tiny morning sun and coffee beans suggest a daily ritual. Red, cream and caramel accents.

assets.title: A colour for every craving
assets.scene: The designer uses a paintbrush to arrange an appetizing rainbow of miniature iced coffee, matcha, fruit tea and whipped cream drinks on orange, red and green cubic plinths. Bold orange, red, fresh green and cream.

assets.title: A little more with every visit
assets.scene: The designer collects a golden star and coin above a red loyalty stamp card, surrounded by coffee cups and a miniature cafe counter. A playful reward journey. Red, gold, caramel and cream accents.

assets.title: Chill hè, one playful moment at a time
assets.scene: The designer relaxes on a red beach chair beside giant iced fruit tea, a little palm tree, sunglasses and a tiny blue pool, holding a sketchbook to design a summer campaign. Coral red, turquoise and sunny yellow.

assets.title: A small card. A thoughtful gift
assets.scene: The designer ties a large red ribbon around a blank cream gift card standing in an open gift box, with a coffee cup, small hearts and gold spark cubes. Red, cream and gold accents.

assets.title: The taste of summer
assets.scene: The designer creates an oversized iced tropical tea surrounded by orange slices, peach wedges, passion fruit, ice cubes and a small sunburst on a summer drink stage. Orange, peach, lemon yellow and red accents.

assets.title: A surprise worth discovering
assets.scene: The designer excitedly opens a red mystery gift box as cute miniature coffee-cup collectible toys and sparkling star cubes emerge. One tiny toy stands on a display pedestal. Red, cream, lavender and gold accents.

assets.title: A café with a personal story
assets.scene: The designer sketches at a cozy little Vietnamese neighborhood cafe with a green facade, wooden stool, phin coffee filter, potted leaves and a warm reading lamp. Deep green, cream and coffee-brown accents.

assets.title: Tea, wrapped in colour
assets.scene: The designer folds colourful blank tea packaging around three large bubble-tea cups, surrounded by tapioca pearls, a paper box dieline and colourful material swatches. Mint, lavender, coral and cream accents.

assets.title: Rewards around the corner
assets.scene: The designer explores a small colourful neighborhood with a giant smartphone showing blank rewards tiles, golden coins, gift boxes and a friendly shop kiosk. Lavender, yellow and mint accents.

assets.title: Insurance, closer to everyday life
assets.scene: The designer holds a glowing turquoise shield protecting a tiny house, a little car and two friendly miniature people, beside a giant smartphone with blank rounded tiles. Blue, teal, mint and warm cream accents.

assets.title: Design for a growing community
assets.scene: The designer paints colourful event posters on blank boards at a friendly university community space, surrounded by tiny students, a stack of books, a microphone and a sprouting tree. Royal blue, orange, lime and cream accents.

assets.title: A quieter frame for living
assets.scene: The designer calmly arranges a minimalist living room with a low wooden lounge chair, soft cream sofa, floor lamp, little side table, potted olive tree and empty picture frame. Sage, oak, sand and cream accents.

assets.title: Off the clock, still creating
assets.scene: The designer happily doodles on an oversized sketchbook, surrounded by a paint palette, chunky coloured pencils, a tiny easel and whimsical little painted cube creatures. Bright coral, cobalt, lemon yellow and mint accents.
